title: Fix Github Sync Issue Linking
description: There is an issue with the synchronization of tickets and github. It shouldnt be possible that an issue has neither milestone or parent issue. Root goals are milestones, goals afterwards are issues with goal label. E.g. Derive Artifact Kinds From Source https://github.com/usalu/semio/issues/428 has nothing. Change/refactor/extend whatever is necessary to get it working.
summary: Enforced goal issue linkage in GitHub sync and documented the behavior.
